notes: Lime video cover: the cover you pick in Edit cover is now saved exactly, instead of a nearby frame that could be a second or more away.
Quick updates now wait for you: when one is ready, Ourlime asks first, and nothing is downloaded or installed until you tap "Update now". Tap Later and the app stays as it is.
Release notes: Settings → Release notes lists what changed in every version and quick update.
Lime video cover: the Finish button in Edit cover works on the first tap, and the frame strip loads even after you've already picked a cover.
E-Hub forms: the keyboard no longer covers what you type in Seller Center, your business account, enquiries and the enquiry form on a provider's page.
Business account: a category you typed is now saved when you tap Save, even if you didn't tap Add first.
Sharing an E-Hub product now sends just the link, so chats show the product's name, price and photo.
Fixes: long descriptions scroll inside their box so you can see what you're typing, image upload problems show a clear message, and the draft delete button reads "Delete draft".
Updates from Google Play: when a new version of Ourlime is out, the app tells you right away and installs it through Play's own update screen, without sending you to the store.
Fixes: the "What's new" list now scrolls, so you can read every note and reach the "Got it" button.
E-Hub is in the app: browse the catalog, open product pages, discover sellers and service providers, view their profiles and send enquiries.
E-Hub Seller Center: set up your storefront, add and edit products, and see how your shop is doing.
Business account: create and manage your business profile from the app.
Course lessons: watch lesson videos, take quizzes and open lesson files (PDF, Word) without leaving the app.
Assignments: hand in a written answer and files, then see your grade and your instructor's feedback.
New progress & grades page for each course: completion, average quiz score and your result for every lesson.
Course reviews: read what other students say and leave your own rating.
Teach on Ourlime: apply to become an instructor, create and publish courses, and grade your students' work.
Events: a new event page with comments, plus a Calendar view that shows what's on each day.
Games: a new Games hub with Trini Wordle and Trini GeoGuesser. Find places across T&T on the map and climb the leaderboard.
Fixes: E-Learning and E-Hub screens that wouldn't load, Seller Center closing on open, broken card layouts, and member names that showed an email address.
